notes: Safer: if HomeZ ever closes unexpectedly 3 times in a few minutes, Home shows a simple safe screen with your apps, Try HomeZ again, and a way back to the TV's own home screen, so the TV is never stuck. New Report a problem on the phone page: details about the TV and HomeZ to copy and send to whoever helps you (no addresses, links or names, and HomeZ never sends it itself). Optimize now has sections: App options (switch off preinstalled apps, and Keep apps ready so chosen apps are never closed as idle) and Built-in services.
